newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR mostly stable, two-month rate dips.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR mostly stable, two-month rate dips.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly steady from Friday's levels ahead of the regular weekly Treasury bill auction later today, traders said.
"Everybody's on a wait and see mode. Although we are expecting rates to go up in the longer-termed bills, we want to see what'll happen in the auction before adjusting our rates," one trader said.
The slight dip in the two-month PHIBOR was just an aberration, he added.
PHIBOR are average swap rates quoted by 20 banks operating in the country.
